concept: ALFATWIN: The Premium Command Center. Deep obsidian backgrounds layered with frosted glass, highlighted by stark metallic gold and silver accents. It merges B2B operational clarity (Swiss grid) with high-end executive aesthetics (Jewel & Luxury).

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule: Enforce extreme weight contrast. Use Black (900) for impact headers and large metrics, paired with Light (300) or Regular (400) for body and labels. No generic medium weights for everything.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Optical alignment over mathematical alignment.

admin_dashboard.structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Subgrid logic for nested cards.
admin_dashboard.widgets: Metrics are col-span-1. Live Map is col-span-2 row-span-2. Activity Feed is col-span-1 row-span-2.

mobile_pwa.structure: Fixed bottom sheets, massive floating action buttons, large touch targets (min 64px for primary actions).

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, mobile bottom sheets, modal overlays, notifications.

cards.classes: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden
cards.premium_detail: For key cards, add an absolute top border highlight: `before:absolute before:top-0 before:inset-x-0 before:h-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-transparent before:via-[#D4AF37] before:to-transparent before:opacity-50`

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-[#050505] font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(212,175,55,0.3)] hover:bg-[#E5C865] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(212,175,55,0.5)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white rounded-full px-6 py-3 hover:bg-white/5 hover:border-white/40 transition-all
buttons.massive_action: w-48 h-48 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D4AF37] to-[#8A7120] text-[#050505] font-black text-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(212,175,55,0.4)] active:scale-95 transition-transform

inputs.classes: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-white/10 text-white placeholder:text-tertiary rounded-xl focus:border-[#D4AF37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]

badges.urgent: bg-red-500/15 text-red-500 border border-red-500/30 font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs uppercase tracking-wider
badges.warning: bg-yellow-500/15 text-yellow-500 border border-yellow-500/30 font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs uppercase tracking-wider
badges.success: bg-green-500/15 text-green-500 border border-green-500/30 font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs uppercase tracking-wider

map.customization: Render map with high contrast. Use a gold pin (#D4AF37) with a pulsing animation for live locations.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Subtle lifts (-translate-y-1) and glow increases for cards.
motion_and_interactions.click: active:scale-95 for all buttons to ensure tactile mobile feedback.
motion_and_interactions.page_transition: Fade in with a slight upward translation (framer-motion).
motion_and_interactions.gps_waiting: Pulsing concentric circles in metallic gold to indicate high-precision location acquisition before allowing the user to tap the massive action button.

brand_logo.description: ALFATWIN Official Logo - Double A in silver and gold. Usage: Login screen, Admin Header, App top bar.

backgrounds.description: Abstract dark obsidian background with metallic gold fluid lines. Usage: Login Screen Background (with a bg-black/50 overlay).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use '@phosphor-icons/react' (Duotone) for a high-end, premium feel rather than generic standard icons.

Implement pure HTML+Tailwind for main structural layouts to allow deep customization. Use Shadcn components strictly for logic-heavy interactive elements (Select, Dropdown, Dialogs), but strip their default borders/backgrounds to match our `surfaces_and_micro_themes`.
Configure Tailwind config colors exactly as specified. Add custom drop-shadow utilities for the gold glows.
For the mobile PWA view, ensure the 'Marcar entrada/salida' button is heavily emphasized using the `massive_action` button style and always visible or highly accessible.
Integrate 'leaflet' and 'react-leaflet'. MANDATORY: Use the provided CartoDB Dark Matter tile URL so the map doesn't clash with the dark UI.
Implement 'data-testid' on ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, map markers, task items) as mandated by the rules.
Configure Montserrat via Google Fonts in index.html or layout wrapper. Apply tracking utilities strictly based on the typography rules to establish the Anti-Default tension.
All JS/JSX files only. No TypeScript configurations or files.
